confluences: Confluence 1: SMC Liquidity Purge + MSNR Resistance + CRT Deviation + Volatility Alignment. The sudden spike to 4355.11 successfully swept the buy-side liquidity resting above the equal highs of the flat weekend range (4348.70), representing a classic Turtle Soup pattern. The immediate rejection back below the Malaysian SNR resistance at 4348.70 confirms a Candle Range Theory (CRT) deviation/fakeout. This high-volatility expansion is validated by the elevated M15 ATR of 10.51, indicating a strong institutional stop-hunt before a bearish reversal.

Confluence 2: Supply Zone + Candlestick Patterns + Quarter Theory + Trend Indicator Alignment. A fresh supply zone has been established between 4350.00 and 4355.11, coinciding with the major psychological Quarter Theory level of 4350.00. The H1 timeframe printed a prominent shooting star/bearish pin bar at 12:00, followed by a strong bearish displacement candle on M15 at 12:30. This price action is aligned with the neutral HTF trend (H4/H1/M15), indicating that the bullish M5 trend was merely a corrective pullback into HTF supply, now rejected by the Ichimoku Kumo boundary.

Confluence 3: Break of Structure (BOS) + Chart Patterns + FVG + Momentum Indicator Alignment. On the M5 timeframe, price executed a bearish Break of Structure (BOS) by closing below the intermediate swing low of 4348.77, completing a double top/Quasimodo distribution pattern. This rapid displacement left an unmitigated bearish Fair Value Gap (FVG) on M5 between 4352.17 and 4350.83. This structural shift is validated by the M15 RSI (14) falling to 52.3 from overbought conditions, confirming a rapid loss of bullish momentum.

Confluence 4: Fibonacci Retracement + Fibonacci Circles + SMC Order Block + Volume Alignment. The spike to 4355.11 represents an exact 0.382 Fibonacci retracement of the massive HTF bearish impulse from 4403.79 to 4324.20. This level aligns with Fibonacci circles acting as dynamic resistance. The subsequent drop confirms the mitigation of a premium bearish order block. This reversal is supported by volume distribution, where the bearish displacement candles show significantly higher relative volume compared to the flat weekend consolidation.

Confluence 5: Standard Deviation Deviation + Trendline Break + Malaysian SNR Support Target + Volatility Band Alignment. The spike to 4355.11 represents a +2 Standard Deviation deviation from the flat weekend mean of 4348.36, which has now broken the micro M5 bullish trendline to the downside. The defensive staff zone at 4350.80 offers a highly asymmetric entry as price retraces to test the broken trendline from below. This setup targets the lower liquidity pool at the Malaysian SNR support of 4324.20, aligned with the upper Bollinger Band rejection on the H1 timeframe.
